newsitem.title: FINLAND: METRA SAYS TO SET NEWS CONFERENCE AT 0930.
newsitem.headline: METRA SAYS TO SET NEWS CONFERENCE AT 0930.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Metra Oy Ab said in a statement released on Wednesday evening it would have a news conference on Thursday at 0930/0630 GMT about its recently announced talks with Italian Fincantieri.
"In the occasion Warstsila Diesel Group President Pentti-Juhani Hintikka and Metra Executive Vice President Ole Johansson will tell about the current situation of the negotiations," Metra said.
Metra said there would be another news conference on the topic in London at 1100 local time.
Metra last Friday announced it had started talks about possible cooperation between its Warsila Diesel and Fincantieri's 50 percent owned New Sulzer Diesel Group.
